title: Mar Mattai & Erbil Citadel
full_text:
8 AM after Breakfast we will head to Mor Mattai Monastery, one of the oldest monasteries in the world.
(We can also remove this visit if you want more time in the city of Erbil).
Head back to Erbil, and head to the citadel to see the buzzling markets there, and explore the bazaar around it.
Visiting the beautiful Jalil Khayat mosque.
Visiting the Syriac Heritage museum.
Free time to shop and explore the city
At night we will explore the district of Ainkawa and its nightlife.
